hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve AMM hook backed by Euler lending vaults. Intercepts all swaps in beforeSwap, computes input/output amounts via a custom bonding curve, deposits input tokens into and withdraws output tokens from Euler vaults, and settles via BeforeSwapDelta. Standard Uniswap v4 concentrated liquidity is disabled; each pool instance is a delegatecall proxy to this implementation contract.
